lines: Rodgers has played 98% of snaps over his last 3 games and 98% on the season. Pass attempts are 34.7 per game recently versus 36.0 for the season.
He averaged 11.3 PPR points over his last 3 games against 14.6 for the season, while his usage-based expectation held at 14.8 recently and 15.2 for the season.
Week 10 is at CIN, which allows the 17th-most PPR points per game to QBs. PIT's implied total is 23.0 points, and the coach said the offense will keep running through Rodgers.
